rules: Never invent chart patterns or levels.

style_rule: Never repeat the same editorial style, opening cadence, emoji pattern or paragraph structure in consecutive posts. Rotate formats based on evidence and recent history.
hook_rule: first 1-2 lines must contain a concrete event, number, level, divergence or surprising observation; never generic introductions
question_rule: one low-friction question only; prefer A/B, breakout/fakeout, level choice or thesis confirmation
writing_rule: Every post must explain why the information matters, what the chart/news says now, and what would invalidate the thesis when technically supported.
technical_rule: Single-asset technical stories require the verified TradingView chart and synchronized current price/support/resistance/target/invalidation values. Never invent a level.
creator_tracking_rule: A creator call becomes an outcome story only after fresh market data verifies the move; measure the result and do not rewrite history.
growth_rule: Track views, likes, comments, shares and post-attributed follower gains separately. Never convert missing metrics to zero.
monetization_rule: Use the relevant $cashtag and chart naturally because eligible Square activity can be attributed, but never promise earnings or returns.
source: frozen preflight opportunity + Creator Brain + engagement strategy
guardrail: The frozen opportunity is authoritative. No downstream stage may change the primary asset. TradingView is mandatory for autonomous market publication.
